# Command-Line Help for `sms-backup-plus-exporter`

This document contains the help content for the `sms-backup-plus-exporter` command-line program.

**Command Overview:**

* [`sms-backup-plus-exporter`↴](#sms-backup-plus-exporter)
* [`sms-backup-plus-exporter convert`↴](#sms-backup-plus-exporter-convert)

## `sms-backup-plus-exporter`

Convert SMS Backup+ EML exports via common message to JSON/CSV/EML/MBOX/JSONL/XML

**Usage:** `sms-backup-plus-exporter [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `convert` — Convert EML tree via common message to the chosen packaging format

###### **Options:**

* `-v`, `--verbose` — Log progress to stderr (inputs, scan/write progress, dedupe summary)
* `--no-summary` — Skip the end-of-run summary on stdout



## `sms-backup-plus-exporter convert`

Convert EML tree via common message to the chosen packaging format

**Usage:** `sms-backup-plus-exporter convert [OPTIONS] --output <OUTPUT>`

###### **Options:**

* `--input <INPUT>` — Path to a .eml file or directory tree of EMLs (Archive/, Sent/, …). Repeat for multiple roots; trees are merged and path-deduped. Default: source_dirs from config/owner.toml when set
* `--owner-phone <OWNER_PHONES>` — Owner phone (E.164 or digits). Repeat for multiple owner numbers. Default: `phones` in config/owner.toml
* `--owner-email <EMAIL>` — Owner email addresses used to detect sent messages when X-smssync-type is missing. Default: `emails` in config/owner.toml
* `--name-mapping <NAME_MAPPING>` — Name mapping CSV (`Phone,Incorrect Name`) for EML export aliases. Default: config/name-mapping.csv when that file exists
* `--output <OUTPUT>` — Output directory for packaging + attachments/
* `--format <FORMAT>` — Output format: `json` (default), `jsonl`, `csv`, `eml`, `mbox`, or `xml`

  Default value: `json`
* `--contacts <CONTACTS>` — vCard CSV or VCF contacts file for phone→name resolution. Optional; without it phone numbers are not resolved to names
* `--vcf <VCF>` — Contacts VCF (alternate to `--contacts`)
* `--obfuscate` — Rewrite output with stable, non-reversible fake names/numbers/text and placeholder media
* `--obfuscate-seed <OBFUSCATE_SEED>` — Optional seed for reproducible obfuscation (implies --obfuscate)
* `--start-date <YYYY-MM-DD>` — Only messages on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, local midnight, inclusive)
* `--end-date <YYYY-MM-DD>` — Only messages before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, local midnight, exclusive)
* `--media-mode <MODE>` — Attachment media: disabled (no files), clone (default), convert, or compress

  Default value: `clone`
* `--media-max-resolution <RES>` — Compress only: max long edge (720p, 1080p, 4k)

  Default value: `1080p`
* `--media-max-fps <MEDIA_MAX_FPS>` — Compress only: max frame rate

  Default value: `30`
* `--media-min-size <MEDIA_MIN_SIZE>` — Compress only: only re-encode videos at/above this size (e.g. 20M)

  Default value: `20M`
* `--media-skip-efficient <MEDIA_SKIP_EFFICIENT>` — Compress only: skip already-efficient HEVC under max resolution (default on)

  Default value: `true`

  Possible values: `true`, `false`
